item.title: 5 signs your small business network needs an upgrade
item.description: Slow Wi-Fi, dropped video calls and mystery outages usually aren't bad luck. Here's how to tell when it's time to modernize.

item.title: Quick tip: label both ends of every network cable during an install. It costs a…
item.description: Quick tip: label both ends of every network cable during an install. It costs a few minutes today and saves hours the next time something breaks.

item.title: Turn on multi-factor authentication today
item.description: Stolen passwords are behind a huge share of account break-ins. Multi-factor authentication is the simplest, cheapest fix.

item.title: Something I like: password managers
item.description: A good password manager means you only remember one strong password, and every other account gets a unique one. It's the single easiest upgrade most people can make.
